description: The file is a shell script that includes functions for extracting variables from a Makefile, checking for missing documentation for commands, and ensuring documentation consistency. It appears to be used for maintaining or verifying documentation coverage for git-related commands.

methods.name: extract_variable
methods.description: Extracts the value of a specified variable from the Makefile by executing make commands and processing output.

methods.name: check_missing_docs
methods.description: Checks for commands that lack associated documentation files or links.

methods.name: check_extraneous_docs
methods.description: Identifies documented commands that are not present in the current command list.
